children: Lexaria Bioscience secured approximately $5.9 million in gross proceeds after holders immediately exercised 453,969 existing warrants at a reduced price of $12.92 per share under inducement offer letters. In consideration, Lexaria will issue new unregistered Series A and Series B warrants, each covering up to 453,969 shares at a $12.67 exercise price, with five-year and 18-month terms, respectively. The company engaged H.C. Wainwright as exclusive placement agent, agreeing to a 7% fee on gross proceeds and issuing 15,889 placement agent warrants at $16.15. Closing is expected on September 9, 2026, with proceeds earmarked for working capital and general corporate purposes.
